stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[6].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

required_fields.statement: A required property missing from the config yields an error naming its dot path.

types.statement: Each of string, integer, number, boolean, array, object rejects a wrong-typed value; booleans are not integers or numbers.

enums.statement: A value not in the enum list yields an error.

number_bounds.statement: A number below minimum or above maximum yields an error; the bounds themselves are accepted.

string_length.statement: A string shorter than minLength or longer than maxLength yields an error; the limits themselves are accepted.

patterns.statement: A string not matching pattern (re.search) yields an error.

nested_paths.statement: Errors inside nested objects, including missing required nested fields, are labelled with dot paths like server.tls.port.

all_errors.statement: Multiple violations are all reported in one run; the CLI exits 1 with errors, 0 when valid, 2 on bad files.

single_file_stdlib.statement: config_validator.py imports only standard-library modules and needs no other project file.
